references.text: The same amount of fine flour (three-tenths of an ephah) mixed with oil as a grain offering for a bull is prescribed for the daily offerings.
The grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil is specified in the same proportions for festival sacrifices.
Three-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for a bull is prescribed for the New Year's feast.
The same amount of grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil for a bull is prescribed for the Day of Atonement.
Basic instructions for the grain offering (mincha) of fine flour (sifted) with oil.
Fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering together with a burnt offering is prescribed at the dedication of the altar.
Ezekiel describes the grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil in his vision of the future temple.
